description: Tribal Climate Change Adaptation Planning Toolkit is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Northern Arizona University | Institute for Tribal Environmental Professionals | Climate Program. This toolkit is a collection of templates and other resources to assist tribes in their climate change adaptation planning process. The materials provided are not "one-size-fits-all" solutions. Users are encouraged to modify the materials to better represent the needs and priorities of their own tribe. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Cultural and Community Services, Economy, People. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
